items.name: FBI
items.headline: Trump says FBI hack might expose Russia "hoax"
items.description: President Trump on Saturday said the reported hack of a crucial FBI database might have a silver lining — it could, he claimed, expose more details of what he called the " Russia Russia Russia hoax ." Why it matters: The president remains laser-focused on many of his past grievances about the FBI , even as the public grows increasingly alarmed about the vulnerability of government infrastructure.

sources.description: GENEVA — Diplomats meeting at the United Nations in Geneva have agreed to start discussing options to regulate lethal autonomous weapons, often called “killer robots.” After a week of negotiations that dragged on until the small hours of Saturday morning, a compromise emerged: countries would have two years to suggest regulations that could be legally binding, but could also be optional.
